newsitem.title: USA: Invesco in talks with AIM Management - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Invesco in talks with AIM Management - WSJ.

text.p: Britain's Invesco Plc is in preliminary talks to acquire closely held AIM Management Group, the 11th-largest U.S. mutual fund company, the Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.
Quoting anonymous sources, the newspaper said the value of the purported merger could approach or exceed $1.8 billion.
Venture-capital firm TA Associates holds a 27-percent stake in Houston-based AIM Management, which oversees $58 billion in assets, according to the Journal.
Spokesmen from both companies declined to comment for the article, the Journal said.
